rules.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-light tracking-tight text-primary
rules.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-normal tracking-tight text-primary

layout_and_spacing.product_grid: grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-x-8 gap-y-16
rules: Use massive negative space. Allow product images to breathe without restricting borders.
Cardless design for product grids. Just the image, title, and price left-aligned underneath.
Forms (Checkout, Login, Admin) must use generous padding (p-8 to p-12) inside clean borders.
Use optical alignment for text and icons.

navigation.style: sticky top-0 z-50 bg-white/85 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-border transition-all
navigation.links: text-sm uppercase tracking-widest font-medium hover:text-accent transition-colors

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-white hover:bg-black/80 rounded-none px-8 py-4 text-sm uppercase tracking-widest transition-all
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-primary text-primary hover:bg-surface rounded-none px-8 py-4 text-sm uppercase tracking-widest transition-all
buttons.ghost: bg-transparent text-primary hover:text-accent px-4 py-2 text-sm transition-colors

inputs.style: bg-transparent border-b border-border rounded-none px-0 py-3 focus:outline-none focus:border-primary focus:ring-0 text-base w-full transition-colors
inputs.label: text-xs uppercase tracking-widest text-text_muted mb-1 block

product_card.image: w-full h-full object-cover transition-transform duration-700 group-hover:scale-105
product_card.title: text-lg font-normal text-primary

seller_stand.wrapper: border border-border p-6 md:p-8 bg-surface/50 mt-12 flex items-center gap-6

interactions.hover: Subtle opacity shifts or color changes. Avoid bouncing or excessive scaling. Elegance is key.
interactions.page_load: Fade in with slight upward translation (framer-motion).
interactions.drawer: Side cart should slide in smoothly from the right with a dark glassmorphic overlay on the main content.

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building 'Beauty Moon', a marketplace for independent Avon sellers. DO NOT mention L'Oréal or Avon directly in visible UI text unless as an imported brand, but the design MUST reflect their high-end, clean, minimalist aesthetic.
IMPORTANT: Apply 'data-testid' to ALL interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links, cart triggers).
Use Shadcn UI but heavily customize the styles to remove the generic 'SaaS/Vercel' look. Strip out aggressive border radiuses (use rounded-none or rounded-sm) and drop shadows.
For the Seller Panel and Admin Dashboard, maintain the minimalist aesthetic. Do not use generic colored admin themes. Keep it black and white with subtle grey borders.
Implement the side cart using a Drawer/Sheet component with a clean, uncrowded layout.
Product cards on the home page and grid must NOT have physical borders or cards. Let the image define the space.
Use Playfair Display for headings and Outfit for body text to create a high-contrast elegant typographic scale.
Use the provided image URLs exclusively. DO NOT use placeholder services like via.placeholder.com.
